answerUrls.description: Explicit answer-page seeds. Parent question joins are emitted only from observed evidence.
answerUrls.title: Answer URLs

commentSortOrder.description: Order builder comment rows by observed order or an explicitly typed metric/timestamp. Unknown selected metrics remain in stable fallback order and are counted.
commentSortOrder.title: Comment Sort Order

cookieString.description: Optional browser-exported name=value; name2=value2 header. Parsed locally into authorized session cookies; the raw header is never emitted or logged.
cookieString.title: Optional Cookie Header String

cookies.description: Optional secret cookies for content the caller is authorized to access.
cookies.title: Authorized Cookies

dedupeMode.description: canonical suppresses overlapping entity rows by stable ID or canonical URL (default); none preserves every observed non-status row. The run manifest reports duplicate_records_suppressed.
dedupeMode.title: Deduplication Mode

includeAnswerUpvoterEdges.description: High-sensitivity opt-in for explicitly labeled answer upvoter identities; requires includeSensitiveRelationshipData=true.
includeAnswerUpvoterEdges.title: Include Answer Upvoter Collections

includeAuthor.description: Retain visible author fields and profile/profile-activity rows. When false, author fields and author rows are removed from the emitted shape; no contact enrichment is performed.
includeAuthor.title: Include Author Rows

includeAuthorSnapshot.description: Opt into bounded public profile snapshots for visible author profile links; profile access/status is separate from answer/comment success and never includes contact enrichment.
includeAuthorSnapshot.title: Include Author Snapshot

includeComments.description: Enable bounded visible comment output when the per-answer cap is positive.
includeComments.title: Include Comment Rows

includeEngagementBreakdown.description: Retain explicitly labeled per-comment reaction breakdowns alongside aggregate reaction labels. Raw labels are preserved and typed companions are added only when the localized number is unambiguous.
includeEngagementBreakdown.title: Include Engagement Breakdown

includeEntityGraph.description: Emit explicit relationship rows even when entity_edge is not listed in resultTypes.
includeEntityGraph.title: Include Entity Graph

includeFeedText.description: Request bounded visible text from explicitly linked Space feed cards; page-level text and complete feed history are excluded.
includeFeedText.title: Include Space Feed Text

includeFieldEvidence.description: Include field_sources and fields_present maps. Disable only when a smaller payload is required; semantic values and protected access fields remain unchanged.
includeFieldEvidence.title: Include Field Evidence

includeHtml.description: Include bounded raw-document HTML when raw evidence is enabled and bounded answer-card HTML when answer cards are extracted.
includeHtml.title: Include HTML

includeMedia.description: Request explicitly rendered media URL fields scoped to question roots, answer/comment nodes, and Topic post cards where the page exposes them.
includeMedia.title: Include Media URLs

includeOutboundLinks.description: Request visible non-Quora links scoped to question roots, answer/comment nodes, and Topic post cards; Quora links, comment permalinks, and links outside the owning scope are excluded.
includeOutboundLinks.title: Include Outbound Links

includeProfileEdges.description: Enable explicitly labeled profile follower/following/followed-question/Space/Topic relationship collections. This does not prove a complete list.
includeProfileEdges.title: Include Profile Relationship Collections

includeQuestion.description: Retain normalized question parent rows when selected in resultTypes.
includeQuestion.title: Include Question Rows

includeQuestionFollowerEdges.description: Enable explicitly labeled question follower or want-answer collections. Sensitive identity rows also require the privacy gate.
includeQuestionFollowerEdges.title: Include Question Follower Collections

includeRawEvidence.description: Add bounded document hash and optional HTML bytes to each page-level entity row.
includeRawEvidence.title: Include Raw Evidence

includeRelatedContent.description: Retain links inside an explicitly labeled related/attached region scoped to answer cards; unlabeled navigation and neighboring regions are excluded.
includeRelatedContent.title: Include Answer Related Content

includeRelationshipCounts.description: Emit privacy-preserving relationship_collection rows with the real observed total (collection_total_text/collection_total_value) but no target identities. Requires relationship_collection in resultTypes. Observed totals are not always a server-confirmed count.
includeRelationshipCounts.title: Include Relationship Collection Counts

includeReplyGraph.description: Enable bounded visible nested comment replies and explicit parent paths; this also enables comment rows. Hidden or unexpanded replies are not inferred.
includeReplyGraph.title: Include Reply Graph

includeSensitiveRelationshipData.description: Explicit privacy gate required for follower, want-answer, and upvoter identity edges.
includeSensitiveRelationshipData.title: Sensitive Relationship Data

includeSpaceContentEdges.description: Retain bounded explicit Space post/question membership edges; this never claims a complete Space inventory.
includeSpaceContentEdges.title: Include Space Content Edges

includeSpaceRoleEdges.description: Enable explicitly labeled Space contributor, moderator, and admin collections.
includeSpaceRoleEdges.title: Include Space Role Edges

includeSpaces.description: Retain Space rows and feed items where the source route exposes them.
includeSpaces.title: Include Space Rows

includeTargetMetadata.description: Retain explicitly visible target link text and image (to_name, to_image_url) on relationship edges. URLs remain evidence; no target navigation or recursive target scraping is performed.
includeTargetMetadata.title: Include Explicit Target Metadata

includeTopics.description: Retain explicit topic links and topic relationships where observed.
includeTopics.title: Include Topic Links

includeUnchanged.description: Retain unchanged semantic entities when incremental state is enabled; output projection does not alter comparison hashes.
includeUnchanged.title: Include Unchanged Items

includeUnresolvedEdges.description: Retain relationship rows whose endpoint URL was not explicitly observed, with unresolved_reason. Disabling this suppresses only those edge rows and does not imply complete relationships.
includeUnresolvedEdges.title: Include Unresolved Edges

language.description: Browser language hint. Short language codes and supported regional aliases are accepted and normalize to the short code; auto keeps the actor default. This does not translate content or prove access.
language.title: Language

maxAnswers.description: Global answer-row cap applied after per-question caps. Zero means no configured global answer cap.
maxAnswers.title: Maximum Answers Total

maxAnswersPerQuestion.description: Maximum visible answer rows retained from each question page.
maxAnswersPerQuestion.title: Maximum Answers per Question

maxCommentDepth.description: Maximum visible nested reply depth when includeReplyGraph is enabled; reaching the bound is not complete history.
maxCommentDepth.title: Maximum Comment Depth

maxCommentsPerAnswer.description: Maximum visible comment rows retained per answer when enabled.
maxCommentsPerAnswer.title: Maximum Comments per Answer

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum independent seed pages processed concurrently in deterministic batches. Each seed owns a page; discovered seeds merge in batch order.
maxConcurrency.title: Maximum Concurrent Seeds

maxGraphEdges.description: Independent cap for deterministic entity_edge rows.
maxGraphEdges.title: Maximum Graph Edges

maxHtmlBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes retained for optional raw HTML evidence.
maxHtmlBytes.title: Maximum HTML Bytes

maxItems.description: Cap for normalized entity/status rows before graph and manifest rows.
maxItems.title: Maximum Entity Rows

maxItemsPerSource.description: Maximum semantic records emitted from each direct URL, query, or typed source. Status and run-manifest rows are preserved. Use 0 for no per-source cap.
maxItemsPerSource.title: Maximum Items Per Source

maxLoadMoreAttempts.description: Bound exact visible continuation-control clicks on direct question, answer, topic, and Space collection pages independently from scrolling. Search seeds fan out through their discovered child URLs and retain their own source accounting.
maxLoadMoreAttempts.title: Maximum Load-more Attempts

maxNavigationRetries.description: Bounded retries after navigation exceptions (e.g. a transient proxy-tunnel handshake failure); exponential backoff is reported in navigation_retry_delays_seconds. Defaults to 2 for reliability.
maxNavigationRetries.title: Maximum Navigation Retries

maxQuestions.description: Maximum question seeds or discovered question pages to process.
maxQuestions.title: Maximum Questions

maxRawEvidenceBytes.description: Hard upper byte cap for returned raw HTML after the maxHtmlBytes cap.
maxRawEvidenceBytes.title: Maximum Raw Evidence Bytes

maxRelatedContent.description: Bound eligible related-content links per answer when enabled; zero emits no related-content items.
maxRelatedContent.title: Maximum Answer Related Content

maxRelationshipItemsPerCollection.description: Bound explicit links emitted from each labeled relationship collection. Zero emits no relationship-collection edges and never means an empty collection.
maxRelationshipItemsPerCollection.title: Maximum Relationship Items per Collection

maxScrollAttempts.description: Bounded lazy-render scroll budget applied during detail traversal; scroll attempts and termination state are reported.
maxScrollAttempts.title: Maximum Scroll Attempts

onlyNewItems.description: Annotate canonical entity rows with new/changed/unchanged/scope_mismatch state and suppress only unchanged semantic rows when includeUnchanged is false. Requires stateStoreId; status, graph, and manifest rows remain visible.
onlyNewItems.title: Only New or Changed Items

outputFields.description: Optional allowlist for compact rows, including bounded dotted paths through nested collections (for example answers.answer_text, comments.comment_text, feed.feed_text, or contributors.contributor_name where applicable). Child identity/URL fields and the actor identity, access/status, source, traversal, graph, filter, and parser-envelope fields remain protected.
outputFields.title: Output Fields

outputFormat.description: Projection after one canonical extraction path. Nested groups emitted answers and comments under explicit question/answer parents; flat keeps entity rows with parent context; edges emits explicit edge rows plus status rows.
outputFormat.title: Output Format

postUrls.description: Explicit standalone Post-page seeds. Only post routes are accepted; emitted with the same topic_post field family topic-discovered posts use (post_title, post_body, post_author_*).
postUrls.title: Post URLs

profileUrls.description: Explicit profile-page seeds. Only profile routes are accepted; emitted as normalized profile rows exactly like a profile route discovered from startUrls.
profileUrls.title: Profile URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy routing. Quora's anti-bot layer blocks the free Datacenter/Automatic tier on roughly half of all real requests (cloud-verified), so this actor always routes through RESIDENTIAL proxies for reliable results regardless of what is selected here — leave this on the default Residential selection unless you need to supply your own proxy URLs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

questionUrls.description: Explicit question-page seeds. Only question routes are accepted.
questionUrls.title: Question URLs

rawEvidenceRetentionDays.description: When zero, suppress raw_html snapshots while retaining hash, size, and redaction diagnostics. Positive values permit bounded HTML for the requested run; external Apify dataset/run retention still applies.
rawEvidenceRetentionDays.title: Raw Evidence Retention Days

redactSensitiveQueryParams.description: Redact narrow credential-like query parameter values in emitted URLs, graph endpoints, redirect chains, and raw HTML. The original document hash remains based on the captured document.
redactSensitiveQueryParams.title: Redact Sensitive URL Query Values

relationshipTypes.description: Explicit relationship-type allowlist for the newly ported follower/following/want-answers/upvoter/space-role relationship collections. Empty leaves the existing always-on content-membership/authorship edges untouched (question_has_topic, answer_authored_by, comment_belongs_to_answer, profile_has_activity, space_has_feed_item, etc.); this allowlist only gates the additional collections below. Sensitive follower/want-answer/upvoter types also require includeSensitiveRelationshipData and their matching collection opt-in.
relationshipTypes.title: Relationship Types

requestDelay.description: Delay between page batches in seconds; this is not an anti-bot bypass guarantee.
requestDelay.title: Request Delay

resultTypes.description: Select normalized entities, explicit graph relationships, relationship-collection counts, status rows, and the final run manifest.
resultTypes.title: Result Types

scrapeDepth.description: Overview emits page-level summaries without answer/comment/activity/feed expansion; detail preserves the current bounded traversal.
scrapeDepth.title: Scrape Depth

searchQueries.description: Native Quora search seeds. Search cards are followed only when their visible URLs are supported.
searchQueries.title: Search Queries

spaceUrls.description: Explicit Space-page seeds for bounded visible feed discovery.
spaceUrls.title: Space URLs

startUrls.description: Question, answer, profile, topic, Space, or native search URLs.
startUrls.title: Quora URLs

stateStoreId.description: Apify key-value store for canonical entity snapshots. Required when onlyNewItems is enabled; never store cookies or credentials here.
stateStoreId.title: Incremental State Store ID

topCommentsOnly.description: Retain only comments with an explicit visible Top/Most helpful/Popular comments label. Unknown comments are excluded and counted; votes and position are not used as top evidence.
topCommentsOnly.title: Top-Labeled Comments Only

topicUrls.description: Explicit Topic-page seeds for bounded visible question discovery.
topicUrls.title: Topic URLs
